title: Spacetime from the least mathematics: a beginner text on one formula, three number planes and what they build
description: A beginner text on how much of spacetime can be built from one very small piece of mathematics, the formula x squared minus k t squared. It follows three number planes (complex, dual and split-complex), boosts, light, a shock wave, a spinning example and the menu of possible spacetimes. It needs school algebra. Nothing in it is a new result: every result is known and credited to its authors.
